decisions.reason: The plug-in line extends the firm's established data integration business and has its own page, so it likely meets aspirations at low marginal cost and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The building digital twin service is only mentioned and its results are uncertain, but industry growth and a 190-person firm provide the slack to keep exploring this emerging market.

The authentication delegation service sits close to the core offer and overlaps with the new Identity Service, so it may be merged into it, but outright withdrawal within a year is unlikely given low carrying costs.
The open GIS development framework underpins the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and supports its project business, so it is strategically central.
The Identity Service was actively promoted at launch as enabling seamless integration of GeoIT applications and fits the direction of integration with enterprise systems, so management would keep it.
